codes.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
codes.INVALID_INPUT: Check the form: some field is missing or invalid.
codes.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find that item. It may have been deleted.
codes.PDF_UNREADABLE: We couldn't open this PDF. It may be damaged or password-protected. Export a fresh copy without a password and upload that. This didn't use any of your analyses.
codes.PDF_NO_TEXT: This PDF has too little selectable text to analyze. If it's a scan or an image, export your CV to PDF from Word, Google Docs or similar, so the text can be selected, and upload that. This didn't use any of your analyses.
codes.PDF_SCANNED: Your CV looks like a scanned image. Most applicant tracking systems (ATS) can't read it, so it may never reach a recruiter. Export it as a PDF from Word, Google Docs or Canva and upload it again. This didn't use any of your analyses.
codes.NOT_A_PDF: That file isn't a PDF. Export your CV as a PDF and upload that.
codes.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than {{size}}. Export it again with compressed images and upload that.
codes.UPLOAD_FAILED: The upload didn't go through. Check your connection and try again.
codes.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: We couldn't save your PDF, so the analysis didn't run. Try again in a few minutes.
codes.STORAGE_MISCONFIGURED: File storage is misconfigured on our side. Retrying won't help — please check back later.
codes.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The analyzer isn't responding right now. Give it a minute and try again.
codes.AI_RATE_LIMITED: The analysis service is busy. Try again in a minute.
codes.AI_MISCONFIGURED: The analyzer is misconfigured on our side. Retrying won't help — please check back later.
codes.AI_BILLING: The analysis service is temporarily unavailable. Nothing was charged.
codes.AI_CONTENT_BLOCKED: The analyzer declined to process this content. Remove anything unusual from the CV or job description and try again.
codes.AI_BAD_FORMAT: We couldn't read the analysis. Try again — it usually works on a retry.
codes.VOICE_UNAVAILABLE: Voice interviews are temporarily unavailable. Nothing was charged. Try again in a few minutes.
codes.VOICE_MISCONFIGURED: The interview room is misconfigured on our side. Retrying won't help — please check back later.
codes.INTERVIEW_NOT_STARTABLE: This interview has already ended. Your feedback will appear under Interviews once it's ready.
codes.INTERVIEW_EXPIRED: This attempt expired: two hours passed without a session, so it was closed and nothing was charged. Rehearse again from the analysis.
codes.INTERVIEW_START_LIMIT: This interview has used all of its starts: every connection to the interviewer counts as one. Rehearse again from the analysis.
codes.INTERVIEW_CONTEXT_MISSING: This interview has no analysis to build questions from. Run a new analysis and rehearse from there.
codes.ANALYSIS_BUSY: An interview for this analysis is in progress. Try again when it ends.
codes.INTERVIEW_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Voice interviews are part of Pro.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
codes.BILLING_UNAVAILABLE: Billing isn't responding right now. Nothing was charged. Give it a minute and try again.
codes.BILLING_MISCONFIGURED: Billing is misconfigured on our side. Nothing was charged. Retrying won't help — please check back later.
codes.ALREADY_SUBSCRIBED: You already have a Pro subscription. Manage it from your account page.
codes.PACK_REQUIRES_PRO: Interview packs are for Pro subscribers. Subscribe to Pro first.
codes.NO_BILLING_ACCOUNT: There's no billing account for you yet. It's created with your first purchase.
codes.BILLING_PORTAL_UNAVAILABLE: Billing management is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
codes.REQUEST_FAILED: The request didn't go through. Check your connection and try again. If it keeps failing, reload the page.
codes.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

analysisQuota.proResets: You've reached this month's fair-use limit. Resets {{date}}.
